scripts.precommit: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run docs && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run test:android
scripts.build: bun run build:rn && bun run build:core
scripts.build:core: bun run build:core:android && bun run build:core:ios
scripts.build:core:android: cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease compileDebugJavaWithJavac compileDebugUnitTestJavaWithJavac publish
scripts.clean: rimraf android/build android/.gradle ios/build tests_react_native/dist tests_react_native/android/build tests_react_native/android/app/build tests_react_native/android/.gradle tests_react_native/ios/build example/android/build example/android/app/build example/android/.gradle example/ios/build && cd packages/react-native && bun run build:clean
scripts.format: bunx google-java-format --replace -i $(find android packages/react-native/android -type f -name "*.java" ! -path "*/node_modules/*" ! -path "*/build/*" ! -path "*/generated/*") && bunx clang-format -i --glob="ios/**/*.{h,cpp,m,mm}" --glob="packages/react-native/ios/**/*.{h,cpp,m,mm}" --style=Google
scripts.format:check: bunx google-java-format --set-exit-if-changed --replace -i $(find android packages/react-native/android -type f -name "*.java" ! -path "*/node_modules/*" ! -path "*/build/*" ! -path "*/generated/*") && bunx clang-format --glob="ios/**/*.{h,cpp,m,mm}" --glob="packages/react-native/ios/**/*.{h,cpp,m,mm}" --style=Google -n -Werror
scripts.e2e:android: cd tests_react_native && npm_config_yes=true npx cavy-cli run-android
scripts.e2e:ios: cd tests_react_native && npm_config_yes=true npx cavy-cli run-ios --scheme=Notifee --simulator "${IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17}"
scripts.smoke:setup: bun run build:rn && cd example && npm install && npm_config_yes=true npx pod-install
